odoo_app: Discuss (video call channel) / Appointments video link

capabilities.name: Create shareable video room (P2P WebRTC)
capabilities.verify: create_webmeet_room skill (rpc:create_webmeet_room, src/lib/modules/webmeet-module.ts) + src/pages/admin/WebmeetPage.tsx 'New room' dialog creating via supabase.rpc('create_webmeet_room', ...) and copying the /meet/<slug> link.

capabilities.name: List active rooms
capabilities.verify: list_webmeet_rooms skill + WebmeetPage.tsx loads webmeet_rooms where ended_at is null.

capabilities.name: End a room
capabilities.verify: end_webmeet_room skill (rpc:end_webmeet_room) + endRoom() handler in WebmeetPage.tsx.

capabilities.name: Screen sharing in-call
capabilities.verify: src/pages/MeetRoomPage.tsx toggles webmeet.isScreenSharing via toggleScreenShare() (useWebmeet hook) — UI-only, no MCP skill toggles or reports screen-share state.
capabilities.notes: Human surface exists in the meeting room itself; not agent-controllable, but a live in-call control isn't typically MCP-operable either — kept partial per dual-surface law strictness.

capabilities.name: Password-protected rooms
capabilities.verify: create_webmeet_room tool_definition accepts p_password (webmeet-module.ts); room join flow presumably checks it (webmeet_rooms table).

capabilities.name: Auto-expiring rooms (TTL)
capabilities.verify: create_webmeet_room supports p_expires_in_minutes and WebmeetPage.tsx / Room interface surfaces expires_at.

capabilities.name: Configurable max participants
capabilities.verify: p_max_participants (2-16, default 8) on create_webmeet_room; WebmeetPage.tsx create dialog has a maxParticipants input.

capabilities.name: Meeting recording
capabilities.verify: No recording field on webmeet_rooms, no recording control in MeetRoomPage.tsx, and no skill mentions recording.
capabilities.notes: Odoo Discuss video calls have no native recording either, but general video-meeting parity (Zoom/Meet-class) expects it; flagged as a gap regardless.

capabilities.name: Attach a WebMeet link to a booking/calendar event automatically
capabilities.verify: A video booking service (booking_services.location_type=video, video_provider=webmeet) creates a webmeet_rooms row per booking from the bookings trigger booking_meeting_and_intake — slug via gen_webmeet_slug, expires end_time + 2 h, closed on cancel/no_show; the link is bookings.meeting_url and reaches the customer in the confirmation and reminder mails.
capabilities.notes: 2026-10-05: wired from the booking side; see booking#video_integration.

capabilities.name: Waiting room / host admits participants
capabilities.verify: No lobby/admit-participant logic found in MeetRoomPage.tsx or webmeet_rooms schema — anyone with the link + password (if set) joins directly.
capabilities.notes: No host-gatekeeping beyond an optional static password.

capabilities.name: In-call text chat alongside video
capabilities.verify: MeetRoomPage.tsx controls (share link, screen share, mic/cam) show no chat panel or chat-related import.
capabilities.notes: Discuss combines chat + video natively; WebMeet is video-only today.
